主要内容: The document titled 'f1111206k.htm' is a Form 6-K filing by Royal Bank of Canada, a Canadian financial institution, with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). The filing is dated January 12, 2012, and it includes information about the issuance of Senior Global Medium-Term Notes, Series E, by the Bank. These notes are linked to the common stock of Illumina, Inc., and the total principal amount issued is $9,058,000. The filing also includes legal opinions from Norton Rose Canada LLP and Morrison & Foerster LLP regarding the validity of the notes under Canadian and New York law. The document is part of the Bank's shelf registration statement on Form F-3 (File No. 333-171806).
